'''Ilun''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who was a subordinate of [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Bessiker]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. After Bessiker's [[Death/Legends|death]], Ilun was promoted to [[Major/Legends|major]], and later served under [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="SWTOR" />
